tool_input.command:
t=$(mktemp -d); cd "$t"
for s in 20260101-010000 20260101-020000 20260101-030000 20260101-040000; do : > "demo-$s.tar.gz"; : > "demo-$s.tar.gz.sha256"; done
R=/Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakh161p12-d
echo "--- dry-run keep 2 (expect oldest two):"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" -q -n --dest="$t" --name demo --keep 2
echo "--- real run keep 2 (expect oldest two deleted):"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" -q --dest "$t" --name demo --keep 2; ls "$t"
echo "--- help rc:"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" -h >/dev/null; echo $?
echo "--- unknown flag rc:"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" --dest "$t" --name demo --bogus >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?

rm -rf "$t"
